question: With which of the following awards was Kuchipudi dancer V Satyanarayana Sarma honoured
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma Shri.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kuchipudi dancer V Satyanarayana Sarma** was honored with the **Padma Shri **award in 1970.
 
• The Padma Shri is the** fourth highest civilian award **in India, given for distinguished service in various fields such as **art, literature, science, and social service.**
 
• Among the many accolades he received were the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowship, the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award, and the Kalidas Samman.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Kalidas Samman **is a prestigious award given by the **Madhya Pradesh** government for outstanding contributions in the field of** arts and literature.**

 
 
• The prize bears the name of the well-known Indian Classical **Sanskrit author Kalidasa.**
 
• **In 1980,** the Kalidas Samman was first given out.​
 
 
 
• The **Kabir Puraskar **is awarded for promotion and preservation of **communal harmony and national integration**.
 
 
• In **1990**, the Indian government launched the **Kabir Puraskar Scheme**, which included a National Award known as the "**KABIR PURASKAR."**
 
 
 
• The** Moortidevi Award** is given for outstanding contribution to** Indian literature.**
 
 
• **​**Presenting the Moortidevi Award every year is the **Bharatiya Jnanpith**, an Indian literary accolade.
